plan.analysis: Inclusion is the weak class (recall 0.294, 138/179 missed) and misses are dominated by small low-contrast vertical smudges/streaks (median missed 33.9px vs train 90.5px; low-size tertile recall 0.137 on n=146). Round 2's 0.5-1.1 uniform + large irregular source 99 barely moved it, so I shift to smaller learnable scales with prefer_small, drop 99, keep thin-streak sources, and paste onto any_class backgrounds for placement diversity (only 10 same-class backgrounds caused no_placement rejects). Patches (0.713) and scratches (0.644) improved with round 2's 0.5-1.1 uniform, so I keep that regime (patches extended slightly smaller to 0.45 to chase the low tertile; scratches use all sources for diversity since missed scratches are thin bright lines that must not be scaled below visibility).
plan.rationale: Spend the budget where recall is worst (inclusion 26 -> cumulative 80, at the diminishing-return threshold, not beyond), while keeping patches/scratches at 12 each so no class is starved (cumulative 35 each, well under cap 105). Inclusion params change from round 2 (smaller learnable range, prefer_small, no source 99, any_class pool) to attack the small-streak misses; patches/scratches keep the round-2 regime that raised their recall, with patches nudged smaller and scratches using the full source pool for thin-line diversity. Total = 50 exactly; all scale spans >= 0.2 and within [0.3,1.4]; max_overlap 0.15 valid.

plan.analysis: Preview check: inclusion pastes are faint thin smudges/streaks (vertical and some horizontal) at small-to-medium scale on diverse any_class backgrounds — matches the low-contrast small vertical misses (median 33.9px) and the no_placement problem is gone. Patches pastes are dark irregular blobs of mixed contrast at medium scale — matches the missed dark patches (median 50px). Scratches pastes are thin faint lines in both orientations — matches the missed thin bright/faint lines. No unrealistic feathering, no oversized or unlearnable pastes, no class wasted. Plan is sound; keep it.
plan.rationale: Preview confirms the pastes look right per class: inclusion = faint small streaks/smudges on varied backgrounds (targets the 138 small low-contrast misses and fixes round-2's no_placement rejects via any_class pool); patches = dark irregular blobs at medium scale (matches missed patches); scratches = thin faint lines both orientations (matches missed thin lines). Sizes sit in the small-to-medium band that the low-size tertiles need. Constraints verified: total 50, headroom respected, cumulative 80/35/35 < 105, all classes >=10, scale spans >=0.2 within [0.3,1.4], sources >=2 (or all), max_overlap 0.15. Keeping the same plan.
